title: Uncertainty Quantification for Financial Foundation Models: A Survey
abstract: arXiv:2610.33109v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial foundation models increasingly support workflows spanning financial question answering, disclosure analysis, forecasting, and decision-making. In these settings, uncertainty may concern whether evidence is valid and available at the relevant time, whether an interpretation is justified, which outcomes remain plausible, or which action is preferred under costs and risk constraints. Because these objects arise at different points in a workflow, uncertainty cannot be reduced to confidence in a final output. We introduce a source-aware framework that distinguishes six sources of uncertainty across evidence and context, model and inference, and outcome and action, while treating agentic workflows as the execution layer through which uncertainty can propagate, change form, or be reduced. We develop a mechanism-based taxonomy grounded in how methods construct or verify uncertainty and reliability representations, and use it to assess

translated_title: 金融基础模型的不确定性量化：综述
translated_abstract: 金融基础模型日益支持涵盖金融问答、信息披露分析、预测和决策等工作流程。在这些场景中，不确定性可能涉及：证据是否有效并在相关时间可用、某种解释是否合理、哪些结果仍有发生的可能，以及在成本和风险约束下哪种行动更可取。由于这些对象出现在工作流程的不同环节，不确定性不能被简化为对最终输出的置信度。我们引入了一个来源感知框架，区分了六大不确定性来源，涵盖证据与情境、模型与推理、结果与行动三个层面，同时将智能体工作流视为不确定性得以传播、改变形式或被缩减的执行层。我们建立了一个基于机制的分类体系，其依据是各类方法如何构建或验证不确定性与可靠性表示，并利用该体系对相关方法进行评估。
tldr: 该综述提出了一个区分六大不确定性来源的来源感知框架，并建立了基于机制的不确定性量化方法分类体系，用以系统评估金融基础模型在从证据到行动的完整工作流程中的不确定性。
en_tdlr: This survey introduces a source-aware framework distinguishing six sources of uncertainty and a mechanism-based taxonomy to systematically assess uncertainty quantification methods across the full workflows of financial foundation models, from evidence to action.
